reference:
Management Programs
2025-01 Hot Work Permit - to include clearance for combustibles and firewatch requirement. Priority 1. Type: Hot Work Permit. Effort: Moderate Procedural.
Description: As per NFPA 51B Chapter 5, remove combustibles within 11 m of hot work or shield them; constant fire watch during the work and monitoring for at least 1 hour after; fire watch to sign off.
Observation: The hot work checklist allowed a 3 m clearance, lower than the recommended 11 m, and had no requirement for fire watch during and after hot work.

2025-04 Formalize Fire Protection System Impairment Programme. Priority 2. Type: Fire Protection Impairment. Effort: Moderate Procedural.
Description: Check the necessity of each impairment before it is made; work with the fire contractor to reduce fire alarm isolations to those required, with proper tracking of all isolations.
Observation: During the visit to the FCC room, it was reported that there are a total of 1451 isolations.

2025-05 To improve management of fuel day tanks of diesel generator sets. Priority 2. Type: Management of back up power supply. Effort: Minor Procedural.
Description: As the fuel tank is manually topped up, implement a procedure to check fuel levels regularly and keep them above 75%.
Observation: The fuel level of the day tank at P04 was noted to be less than 25%.

2025-08 Improve housekeeping in electrical rooms. Priority 2. Type: Housekeeping. Effort: Minor Procedural.
Description: Remove storage of combustible materials from the L22M LV switch room and MDF room.
Observation: Tables, tools, cardboard boxes and other items were stored in the Level 22M LV switch room and MDF room.

Physical Protection
2025-06 Lock Open Hosereel Firewater Valve. Priority 3. Type: Fire Protection System Operation. Effort: Minor Capital.
Description: Lock open the valves on the hosereel firewater supply line to prevent tampering or accidental closing.
Observation: At the L43 hosereel pump room, the valves were not locked open.
